input: path is a primitive nonempty String beginning with '/'. The paired domain uses ASCII characters U+0001 through U+007F, excludes NUL, and has length p in [1, 4294967294] supported by both runtimes. Repeated separators, trailing separators, empty components, '.', '..' and names containing dots are supported. Relative paths, boxed strings and non-ASCII inputs are outside this declared domain. Preconditions are not checked at runtime.
return: An absolute lexical path String with one leading '/', one separator between retained names, and no trailing separator unless the result is '/'. Empty components and exact '.' components are discarded; exact '..' removes the last retained name when one exists and otherwise leaves root unchanged. All other names, including '...' and '.hidden', are preserved literally. The component stack is the normalized prefix after each processed component. This does not resolve symlinks, access the filesystem, check existence, preserve special double-leading-slash semantics, or expand '~'.
mutation_aliasing: No caller-visible mutation, filesystem access or persistent Solution state. Primitive strings have value semantics; returned string identity is not part of the contract. The split component Array and retained-name stack are local.
numeric: The paired length bound p <= 4294967294 keeps the at-most-p + 1 split components within JavaScript's 4294967295-element Array length limit. ASCII makes Python character counts and JavaScript UTF-16 code-unit counts agree. Lengths and stack counts are exact Numbers; no numeric path interpretation or bitwise coercion is performed.
complexity: O(p) time and O(p) auxiliary space including the complete split sequence, retained-name stack and returned string, under linear-time string split/join and amortized constant-time Array stack operations. No repeated full-string concatenation occurs inside the loop.
source_accounting: The complete standalone source is 408 UTF-8 bytes, including the Solution wrapper, split/join operations, stack updates and terminal newline. No helper import, generated implementation or hidden source expansion exists. Any eventual judge adapter is additional charged source.
